SELECT DISTINCT sat.alarm_type_id AS alarmTypeId, sat.type_name AS typeName, sat.icon AS icon, sat.type_value AS typeValue, sat.alarm_source AS alarmSource FROM vm_order_algorithms t1 INNER JOIN vm_algorithm_info_t t2 ON t1.algorithm_code = t2.algorithm_code INNER JOIN vm_algorithm_alarm al ON t2.algo_min_type_code = al.algo_min_type INNER JOIN sys_alarm_type sat ON al.alarm_type = sat.type_value WHERE sat.delete_flag = 0 AND sat.alarm_source = '1' AND t2.delete_flag = 0 AND al.delete_flag = 0 AND t1.delete_flag = 0 AND t1.ord_status IN ( 0, 1, 2 ) AND t1.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and t1.industry_code = #{industryCode} ORDER BY sat.alarm_type_id ASC
